fullContentHtml:
CTET September Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the notification for the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) September 2026 examination. Candidates can also check all the details on the official Sarkari Result website. The online application process for CTET September Recruitment 2026 has started on 25 August 2026, and candidates can apply till 01 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for CTET September Online Form 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 May 2026
  • Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 15-18 June 2026
  • Form Re-Open
  • Application Start Date : 25 August 2026
  • Last Date : 01 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • Fees For Single Paper
  • General, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 500/-
  • Fees For Both Paper
  • General, OBC : Rs.1200/-
  • SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 600/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

  • Apply Online (Re-Open)
  • Download Re-Open Notice

  • Download Notification
